title: Gromov-Wasserstein Autoencoders
tldr_zh: 用 GW 度量直接匹配 latent 与 data 距离结构，替换 ELBO，解耦与聚类上不改目标即优于 VAE 系基线
tldr_en: Replaces ELBO with GW metric to match latent and data distance structures, outperforming VAE baselines on disentanglement and clustering
